meta.title: AlmaLinux Shop local test site
meta.description: WordPress, WooCommerce 11.2.1, Twenty Twenty-Five and this theme, with WooCommerce's sample products. Used by npm run dev.
meta.author: AlmaLinux OS Foundation Promo SIG

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/media.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';
require_once WC_ABSPATH . 'includes/admin/importers/class-wc-product-csv-importer-controller.php';
require_once WC_ABSPATH . 'includes/import/class-wc-product-csv-importer.php';

// Import WooCommerce's sample products with its own CSV importer, which (unlike the
// WordPress XML importer) creates the global Color attribute the variations need.
class AlmaLinux_Shop_Dev_Mapper extends WC_Product_CSV_Importer_Controller {
	public function map( $headers ) {
		return $this->auto_map_columns( $headers, false );
	}
}
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
$file    = WC_ABSPATH . 'sample-data/sample_products.csv';
$probe   = new WC_Product_CSV_Importer( $file, array( 'lines' => 1, 'parse' => false ) );
$mapping = ( new AlmaLinux_Shop_Dev_Mapper() )->map( $probe->get_raw_keys() );
$result  = ( new WC_Product_CSV_Importer( $file, array( 'mapping' => $mapping, 'parse' => true ) ) )->import();
foreach ( $result['failed'] as $error ) {
	error_log( 'Sample product import failed: ' . $error->get_error_message() );
}

// Edge cases from docs/TESTING.md: a very long product name, and a product with no image.
$long = new WC_Product_Simple();
$long->set_name( 'AlmaLinux Community Edition Heavyweight Organic Cotton Zip-Up Hoodie with Embroidered Logo and Extra Long Name' );
$long->set_regular_price( '54.00' );
$long->save();

$no_image = new WC_Product_Simple();
$no_image->set_name( 'Sticker With No Image' );
$no_image->set_regular_price( '3.00' );
$no_image->save();

// The sample data has no tags, so tag a few products to give the tag archive something to show.
foreach ( wc_get_products( array( 'limit' => 4, 'type' => array( 'simple', 'variable' ) ) ) as $product ) {
	wp_set_object_terms( $product->get_id(), 'Community favorite', 'product_tag', true );
}

// Turn on attribute archives so the theme's taxonomy-product_attribute template gets used.
foreach ( wc_get_attribute_taxonomies() as $attribute ) {
	wc_update_attribute( $attribute->attribute_id, array( 'name' => $attribute->attribute_label, 'slug' => $attribute->attribute_name, 'type' => $attribute->attribute_type, 'order_by' => $attribute->attribute_orderby, 'has_archives' => true ) );
}

// WooCommerce makes these pages on install. This is a safety net in case it didn't.
WC_Install::create_pages();

<?php
// Replace the sample categories with the shop's real ones (Apparel, Hats, Drinkware, Bags, Stickers), with thumbnails and descriptions.
require '/wordpress/wp-content/themes/almalinux-shop/dev/categories.php';

<?php
// A separate request, so the attribute archives turned on above are registered before the permalinks are rebuilt.
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
flush_rewrite_rules();
